newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA - MERKO SHARE ISSUE OVERSUBSCRIBED.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA - MERKO SHARE ISSUE OVERSUBSCRIBED.

text.p: A share issue by Estonian construction company Merko was oversubscribed 2.93 times, investment house Baltic Cresco said on Tuesday.
Merko issued 722,705 shares to raise its share capital to 29 million kroons and its equity to 100 million kroons.
All subscriptions for up to 100 shares will be met, Indrek Rahumaa, head of Cresco's corporate finance, told Reuters.
Investors who subscribed to more than 100 shares will probably get less than three times the subscribed amount.
"Small investors are preferred so as to get a better share distribution," Rahumaa said.
Merko has also applied to list its shares on the Tallinn bourse.
It had turnover of 209 million kroons and a net profit of 9.9 million kroons in 1996.
Turnover in the first quarter of 1997 was 72 million kroons and its net profit was 5.1 million kroons.
